# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

[ Explore the portfolio ][65]
[Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch representing adhesives and coatings
solutions for flexible materials.] Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch
representing adhesives and coatings solutions for flexible materials.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

[ Discover the innovation ][66]
[A person holding an open plastic food container filled with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a
glowing edge highlighting the packaging.] A person holding an open plastic food container filled
with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.

# Empowering **local communities** to create lasting impact

Bostik proudly launches its Community Grant Programme to empower impactful local initiatives around
the world. By supporting community organizations and local partners, the programme helps bring
sustainable, meaningful projects to life, strengthening connections, fostering collaboration, and
creating lasting positive change where it matters most.

[ Discover the programme ][67]
[A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.]

# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

## Choose a roofer certified by GAF with confidence

As North America’s largest roofing manufacturer, GAF is an industry leader that produces quality,
innovative roofing materials. Get peace of mind by working with a contractor certified by GAF¹ who
can offer our strongest warranties.
[ Find a contractor ][199]
1Contractors enrolled in GAF certification programs are not employees or agents of GAF, and GAF does
not control or otherwise supervise these independent businesses. Contractors may receive benefits,
such as loyalty rewards points and discounts on marketing tools from GAF for participating in the
program and offering GAF enhanced warranties, which require the use of a minimum amount of GAF
products. Your dealings with a Contractor, and any services they provide to you, are subject to the
[Contractor Terms of Use][200].

### Asphalt shingles

Beauty. Durability. Affordability. Color. Energy efficiency. Whatever your priority, we have your
shingle. Compare residential roofing shingles here.

### Asphaltic system components

A roof system is so much more than shingles. Explore the residential roofing products that make up a
complete roofing system.

[GAF Solar roofing contractor in front of home holding solar roof shingles]

### Solar roofing

A beautiful roof. With solar energy. It's that simple. The Timberline Solar™ roofing system is based
on innovations so advanced they make solar simple. Choose a reliable roof, GAF-backed warranties,
and clean energy for your home.
[ Learn about solar ][203]

### TPO roofing systems

Take the hassle out of rooftop challenges with flexible TPO roofing system products and accessories.

building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in

### Building Envelope Systems for Any Project

Our building material systems are designed to work together for a continuous, air-tight and
waterproof solution in the most extreme environmental conditions.



Air Barrier Systems

Comprehensive air barrier systems protecting against air and moisture infiltration with self-adhered
and fluid-applied membranes, sealants, flashings and transition assemblies.

Commercial Glazing Systems

Everything you need for air- and watertight fenestration and wall assemblies in new construction or
restoration applications.  

Traffic Systems

Liquid-applied waterproofing membranes for vehicular and pedestrian applications, delivering
long-term durability in high-traffic areas.

Waterproofing

We provide fluid-applied, sheet-applied, and hybrid waterproofing systems with primers, drainage,
and other accessories for maximum below-grade protection.

PUMA Technology

Traffic and waterproofing systems featuring PUMA (polyurethane-methacrylate) technology for
exceptional abrasion resistance, crack-bridging and fast cure.

### Building Envelope Systems for Any Project

Our building material systems are designed to work together for a continuous, air-tight and
waterproof solution in the most extreme environmental conditions.



Air Barrier Systems

Comprehensive air barrier systems protecting against air and moisture infiltration with self-adhered
and fluid-applied membranes, sealants, flashings and transition assemblies.

Commercial Glazing Systems

Everything you need for air- and watertight fenestration and wall assemblies in new construction or
restoration applications.  

Traffic Systems

Liquid-applied waterproofing membranes for vehicular and pedestrian applications, delivering
long-term durability in high-traffic areas.

Waterproofing

We provide fluid-applied, sheet-applied, and hybrid waterproofing systems with primers, drainage,
and other accessories for maximum below-grade protection.

PUMA Technology

Traffic and waterproofing systems featuring PUMA (polyurethane-methacrylate) technology for
exceptional abrasion resistance, crack-bridging and fast cure.

# BASEKIM Leading Manufacturer and Exporter of Bitumen and Industrial Chemicals

BASEKIM Chemical Production is producer and exporter of high quality and competitive price with
various types and grades including bituminous production grade **[bitumen 60/70][356]** and 80/100
bitumen 115/15 MC for road construction, paving and isolation, insulation well drilling mud chemical
including Gilsonite natural asphalt powder 200 mesh for fluid loss control and cementing, caustic
soda flakes, calcium chloride, polyanionic cellulose, starch, sulphonated asphalt, CMC, LABSA
TEXAPON SLES sulfonic acid plus export of paraffin wax in light and heavy grades also fully refined
and semi refined.We export fully refined and semi refined candle wax petroleum jelly vaseline for
cosmetic, medical usage along with rubber process oil high and low viscosity and carbon black N330
N600.

[[OIL WELL DRILLING MUD]][357]

## [OIL WELL DRILLING MUD][358]
* gilsonite (natural asphalt, gilsonit)
* CMC (carboxymethyl cellulose)
* PAC (polyanionic cellulose)
* Starch
* Sulphonated asphalt
* Calcium chloride
* LABSA (linear alkyl benzene sulfonate) Sulfonic acid
* SLS (Sodium Lauryl Sulfate)
* SLES (Sodium lauryl ether sulfate)TEXAPON
* Casutic soda (sodium hydroxide)

# BASEKIM Leading Manufacturer and Exporter of Bitumen and Industrial Chemicals

BASEKIM Chemical Production is producer and exporter of high quality and competitive price with
various types and grades including bituminous production grade **[bitumen 60/70][356]** and 80/100
bitumen 115/15 MC for road construction, paving and isolation, insulation well drilling mud chemical
including Gilsonite natural asphalt powder 200 mesh for fluid loss control and cementing, caustic
soda flakes, calcium chloride, polyanionic cellulose, starch, sulphonated asphalt, CMC, LABSA
TEXAPON SLES sulfonic acid plus export of paraffin wax in light and heavy grades also fully refined
and semi refined.We export fully refined and semi refined candle wax petroleum jelly vaseline for
cosmetic, medical usage along with rubber process oil high and low viscosity and carbon black N330
N600.

coating solutions, from the full and versatile range of product, superior performance for any type

### Boero LifeCycle

An integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and services to meet the most
complex requirements.

We promote the Boero LifeCycle with a dedicated team, focused on the best maintenance and aftersales
service to superyacht: shipyards, captains and management, offering global support, product
information and service. We support the Boero LifeCycle with our technical services, offering
practical coatings advice, specification, inspection and various levels of training.

### Boero Technical Service

Boero YachtCoatings actively engages in customer service by taking our involvement with our
customers past the point of the actual sale of our products into the shipyard, dry dock,
construction site and workshops to assist our customers obtain the required coating finish and to
conform to the project coating specification.

staff, known as Boero Coating Advisors. Boero Coating Advisors are located in most of the markets
where Boero YachtCoatings is promoting and selling products, being part of the local technical
service team and report to the local Technical Service Manager.

## PRODUCTS

### Anti-Fouling

A range of high-tech anti-fouling products offering protection with products suited for all
conditions and requirements with guaranteed performance.

[Daily anti-aging cream][47]

### Primers

Full range of primers for all substrates, above and below waterline, providing excellent adhesion,
protection and solid foundation for the following coatings.

### Fillers

Comprehensive range of fillers, to suit all customers and market needs with proven track record,
offering the lightest and most flexible superyacht filler on the market.

### Undercoats

A range of products designed to provide the best surfaces for finishing and topcoats that promote
adhesion, with excellent sanding properties and offer a stable base for colour depth and longevity.

### Topcoats

Topcoat product to suit all needs, offered in a range of colours, with good colour stability, UV
resistance and high gloss finish. The best finish for any surface that requires long lasting
protection and colour.

### Challenger PRO

Premium range of topcoat products, offering a versatile assortment of finishes and colours with
either single or base & clearcoat systems, including metallics and special effects. A range of
solvents and additives are included for a variety of application conditions and repairs.

### Varnishes

A range of wood treatments and varnishes, to preserve and enhance the beauty of wood finish in the
harsh marine environment.

### Tank Coatings

Range of specialist tank coatings, to suit the toughest requirements, all with recognised
certification.

### Other Products

Range of additions products required for various painting and specialist tasks.

### Durepox

Durepox is a cutting-edge epoxy urethane primer known for its fast application and superior
adhesion. Used by top racing teams.

[Daily anti-aging cream][48]

## SUPERYACHT

Boero YachtCoatings offer an integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and
services in order to meet the most complex requirements. From the design, development and building
of a new yacht, the yacht aftersales support during service, to the maintenance in drydock or refit,
we stand by our customers during the entire boat lifecycle at every stage.

[Discover Superyachts][49]

## DEALER NETWORK

Boero YachtCoatings has a specialised network of dealers in the key yachting locations, each
providing the highest standard of service, stock and support to the yachting market.
Challenger Mix, the tintometric colour system of Challenger Pro topcoats, is available in a growing
number of locations, offering customers Challenger Pro topcoat colours in solid, metallic and
special effect finishes.

[Dealer List][50]

## TRAINING ACADEMY

Boero has a training academy, for the education and training of customers and staff. With a mix of
courses for different customer types, the Academy offers both theory and practical course in many
specialist area of yacht coatings, from yachting product range induction to specialist spray
finishes.
The Academy offers courses in our training centre, or in the field and on-site. The fully equipped
training centre as all the latest application tools and equipment for the demonstration of a single
specialist product to the full range of a typical yacht coating systems. Highly qualified trainers
are on hand to introduce the products, demonstrate, train or guide on the best application methods
to ensure the best possible results from the wide range of product technologies.

[Discover More][51]

where Boero YachtCoatings is promoting and selling products, being part of the local technical
service team and report to the local Technical Service Manager.

[Discover Techical Services][45]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Full range of products

Boero YachtCoatings has a comprehensive range of products and coating solutions that cover all
requirements for both yacht and superyacht painting. Coatings that cover above and below waterline,
exterior and interior systems and all types of tanks and specialist areas.
With a variety of product options in each product group: Anti-fouling, Fillers, Primers, Tank
coatings and Topcoats – Boero YachtCoatings has a coating solution to suit all needs, offering
performance in the most demanding of environments.
Boero YachtCoatings offer complete coating systems to suit a variety of uses, application,
environmental conditions and expected finish.

[Discover Products][46]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

## PRODUCTS

### Anti-Fouling

A range of high-tech anti-fouling products offering protection with products suited for all
conditions and requirements with guaranteed performance.

[Daily anti-aging cream][47]

### Primers

Full range of primers for all substrates, above and below waterline, providing excellent adhesion,
protection and solid foundation for the following coatings.

### Fillers

Comprehensive range of fillers, to suit all customers and market needs with proven track record,
offering the lightest and most flexible superyacht filler on the market.

### Undercoats

A range of products designed to provide the best surfaces for finishing and topcoats that promote
adhesion, with excellent sanding properties and offer a stable base for colour depth and longevity.

### Topcoats

Topcoat product to suit all needs, offered in a range of colours, with good colour stability, UV
resistance and high gloss finish. The best finish for any surface that requires long lasting
protection and colour.

### Challenger PRO

Premium range of topcoat products, offering a versatile assortment of finishes and colours with
either single or base & clearcoat systems, including metallics and special effects. A range of
solvents and additives are included for a variety of application conditions and repairs.

### Varnishes

A range of wood treatments and varnishes, to preserve and enhance the beauty of wood finish in the
harsh marine environment.

### Tank Coatings

Range of specialist tank coatings, to suit the toughest requirements, all with recognised
certification.

### Other Products

Range of additions products required for various painting and specialist tasks.

### Durepox

Durepox is a cutting-edge epoxy urethane primer known for its fast application and superior
adhesion. Used by top racing teams.

[Daily anti-aging cream][48]

## SUPERYACHT

Boero YachtCoatings offer an integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and
services in order to meet the most complex requirements. From the design, development and building
of a new yacht, the yacht aftersales support during service, to the maintenance in drydock or refit,
we stand by our customers during the entire boat lifecycle at every stage.

[Discover Superyachts][49]

## DEALER NETWORK

Boero YachtCoatings has a specialised network of dealers in the key yachting locations, each
providing the highest standard of service, stock and support to the yachting market.
Challenger Mix, the tintometric colour system of Challenger Pro topcoats, is available in a growing
number of locations, offering customers Challenger Pro topcoat colours in solid, metallic and
special effect finishes.

[Dealer List][50]

## TRAINING ACADEMY

Boero has a training academy, for the education and training of customers and staff. With a mix of
courses for different customer types, the Academy offers both theory and practical course in many
specialist area of yacht coatings, from yachting product range induction to specialist spray
finishes.
The Academy offers courses in our training centre, or in the field and on-site. The fully equipped
training centre as all the latest application tools and equipment for the demonstration of a single
specialist product to the full range of a typical yacht coating systems. Highly qualified trainers
are on hand to introduce the products, demonstrate, train or guide on the best application methods
to ensure the best possible results from the wide range of product technologies.

## Product Overview

Decades of experience and hard workmanship have resulted in our range of unique waterproofing
products. Since our establishment in 1998, our comprehensive product range and fields of application
have continuously grown. Our constant focus on innovation allows us to improve existing products
while concurrently developing new innovative systems. Product efficacy, quality, sustainability, and
ease of use are the key drivers in our product development.

Product overview

## BPA Worldwide

Advanced system-based solutions, numerous product patents, independent product accreditations and
competent consulting, has allowed BPA to become a Global Leader in the provision of innovative
Structural Waterproofing and Sealing Systems. This is proven by many blue chip project references
worldwide.

BPA Worldwide

## MADE BY BPA

Our goal is to continuously optimize our products and develop new solutions to match the needs and
requirements of our customers, while still ensuring value. Our high-quality structural waterproofing
and sealing products undergo, both rigorous and regular, quality checks to ensure optimum
performance in the field. Our main production facilities are located in Germany and Switzerland.

## References

Our products have been proven to be the effective and reliable waterproofing solution worldwide. We
have demonstrated our skills and product quality in many high-profile building projects with varying
degrees of difficulty and challenge.

[References][63]

## Quality Management

Our quality management system, conforming to DIN EN ISO 9001:2008 standard accredited by TÜV SÜD
Management Service GmbH, is the driving force within our business and ensures that we meet and often
exceed our customer's expectations. Customer focus and the highest quality standards in both product
and service are at the core of our business.

[Quality Management][64]

## Stifterverband - Innovative through research

07.04.2022

During the last years BPA received many Awards. We are proudly announce that we were awarded for the
second time by the traditional STIFTERVERBAND for being highly innovative!

[Read more … Stifterverband - Innovative through research][65]

## Our memberships

## The Company

BPA GmbH, with its headquarters located in Herrenberg Germany, has been successfully involved in the
development, production, consulting and distribution of high-quality construction sealing systems
for over 18 years. We offer site and objective specific system solutions for water-impermeable
concrete structures in the fields of construction, civil engineering and tunnel construction.

## Product Overview

Decades of experience and hard workmanship have resulted in our range of unique waterproofing
products. Since our establishment in 1998, our comprehensive product range and fields of application
have continuously grown. Our constant focus on innovation allows us to improve existing products
while concurrently developing new innovative systems. Product efficacy, quality, sustainability, and
ease of use are the key drivers in our product development.

Product overview

## BPA Worldwide

Advanced system-based solutions, numerous product patents, independent product accreditations and
competent consulting, has allowed BPA to become a Global Leader in the provision of innovative
Structural Waterproofing and Sealing Systems. This is proven by many blue chip project references
worldwide.

BPA Worldwide

## MADE BY BPA

Our goal is to continuously optimize our products and develop new solutions to match the needs and
requirements of our customers, while still ensuring value. Our high-quality structural waterproofing
and sealing products undergo, both rigorous and regular, quality checks to ensure optimum
performance in the field. Our main production facilities are located in Germany and Switzerland.

## References

Our products have been proven to be the effective and reliable waterproofing solution worldwide. We
have demonstrated our skills and product quality in many high-profile building projects with varying
degrees of difficulty and challenge.

[References][63]

## Quality Management

Our quality management system, conforming to DIN EN ISO 9001:2008 standard accredited by TÜV SÜD
Management Service GmbH, is the driving force within our business and ensures that we meet and often
exceed our customer's expectations. Customer focus and the highest quality standards in both product
and service are at the core of our business.

[Quality Management][64]

second time by the traditional STIFTERVERBAND for being highly innovative!

BPA GmbH, with its headquarters located in Herrenberg Germany, has been successfully involved in the
development, production, consulting and distribution of high-quality construction sealing systems
for over 18 years. We offer site and objective specific system solutions for water-impermeable
concrete structures in the fields of construction, civil engineering and tunnel construction.

## Australia’s Leading Provider of Insulation, Tapered Insulation, and Waterproofing Solutions

# Suppliers of high-quality waterproofing and insulation products for use on residential, commercial
# infrastructure and mining projects.

In this new era of sustainable building and responsible living, we are driving the industry to find
superior solutions for building regulation and certification. We assist you to improve the quality
and compliance of construction work throughout Australia.
Improved insulation capacities support the overall energy efficiency as well as impacting many other
parts of your building projects, such as electronics, which can create all sorts of related fire and
electrocution hazards.
[ Our Projects ][73]

## why work with us

### Over 25+ years in the construction business and a proven track record in providing architectural
### and building solutions.

[ MORE ABOUT US ][74]

## how we stand out

### PROVEN DURABILITY

Real-life membrane samples are consecutively tested by the external laboratory Belgian Building
Research Institute (BBRI) an supervised by independent quality-control organisation SGS
International in different continents and climate zones.

The life expectancy of our [waterproofing membranes][75] is currently 25 to 35 years based on the
actual condition of exposed DuO membranes worldwide.

### LOCAL EXPERTISE

Enduroflex is based in Sydney’s Northern Beaches and has been servicing  Australia with
DuO waterproofing membranes. DuO has been installed in Australia and New Zealand for more than 15
years.

The product is developed and adapted to withstand the local climate conditions and is fully aligned
with local application procedures, standards and regulations.

### PROVEN DURABILITY

Real-life membrane samples are consecutively tested by the external laboratory Belgian Building
Research Institute (BBRI) an supervised by independent quality-control organisation SGS
International in different continents and climate zones.

The life expectancy of our [waterproofing membranes][75] is currently 25 to 35 years based on the
actual condition of exposed DuO membranes worldwide.

### LOCAL EXPERTISE

Enduroflex is based in Sydney’s Northern Beaches and has been servicing  Australia with
DuO waterproofing membranes. DuO has been installed in Australia and New Zealand for more than 15
years.

The product is developed and adapted to withstand the local climate conditions and is fully aligned
with local application procedures, standards and regulations.

# FÓLIE FATRAFOL

Hydroizolační fólie Fatrafol zabraňují pronikání vody a vlhkosti do stavebních konstrukcí i
interiérů. Chrání tak stavby před poškozením.

[Produkty][36][Kontakty][37]

#### Komplexní řešení

Fatrafol nabízí širokou škálu hydroizolačních fólií pro střechy, základy, terasy i vodní plochy.

#### Odolnost a životnost

Fólie Fatrafol jsou UV stabilní, odolné vůči povětrnostním vlivům, výkyvům teplot i agresivním
látkám.

#### Prověřená kvalita

Dlouhodobé zkušenosti s výrobou hydroizolačních fólií, vlastní vývoj a realizace ve více než 50
zemích světa.

#### Podpora a servis

Profesionální [technická podpora][38], odborná školení a certifikované realizační firmy.

## Produkty

Nejpoužívanější fólie

### FATRAFOL 810/V (810)

FATRAFOL 810 je střešní hydroizolační fólie vyrobená na bázi PVC-P, je vyztužená polyesterovou
mřížkou. Určená pro **mechanicky kotvené ploché střechy** s vynikající odolností proti UV záření a
povětrnostním vlivům.

[více o produktu][39]
[FATRAFOL 810/V (810)]
O2 arena, Praha

### Střešní hydroizolační systém

Slouží k izolaci plochých střech, teras a balkónů.
[Mechanicky kotvená střecha][40][Lepená střecha][41][Přitížená střecha][42][Balkón a
terasa][43][Zelená střecha][44][Střešní hydroizolační systém TPO][45]

### Zemní hydroizolační systém

Určen pro izolaci staveb proti zemní vlhkosti, tlakové vodě, speciálním kapalinám a radonu.
[Izolace proti vodě][46][Izolace tunelů][47][Chemické izolace][48][Izolace proti zemní vlhkosti][49]

### Systém pro izolaci jezírek a vodních ploch

Fólie a doplňky určené k izolaci zahradních jezírek, rybníků a biotopů.
[Izolace nádrží na pitnou vodu][50][Izolace vodohospodářských staveb][51][Izolace jezírek][52]

### Doplňky

Přispívají k vytvoření dokonalé těsnosti a účinnosti izolačního pláště.

dlaždice][56][Geotextilie][57]

# FÓLIE FATRAFOL

Hydroizolační fólie Fatrafol zabraňují pronikání vody a vlhkosti do stavebních konstrukcí i
interiérů. Chrání tak stavby před poškozením.

[Produkty][36][Kontakty][37]

#### Komplexní řešení

Fatrafol nabízí širokou škálu hydroizolačních fólií pro střechy, základy, terasy i vodní plochy.

#### Odolnost a životnost

Fólie Fatrafol jsou UV stabilní, odolné vůči povětrnostním vlivům, výkyvům teplot i agresivním
látkám.

#### Prověřená kvalita

Dlouhodobé zkušenosti s výrobou hydroizolačních fólií, vlastní vývoj a realizace ve více než 50
zemích světa.

#### Podpora a servis

Profesionální [technická podpora][38], odborná školení a certifikované realizační firmy.

## Produkty

Nejpoužívanější fólie

### FATRAFOL 810/V (810)

FATRAFOL 810 je střešní hydroizolační fólie vyrobená na bázi PVC-P, je vyztužená polyesterovou
mřížkou. Určená pro **mechanicky kotvené ploché střechy** s vynikající odolností proti UV záření a
povětrnostním vlivům.

[více o produktu][39]
[FATRAFOL 810/V (810)]
O2 arena, Praha

### Střešní hydroizolační systém

Slouží k izolaci plochých střech, teras a balkónů.
[Mechanicky kotvená střecha][40][Lepená střecha][41][Přitížená střecha][42][Balkón a
terasa][43][Zelená střecha][44][Střešní hydroizolační systém TPO][45]

### Zemní hydroizolační systém

Určen pro izolaci staveb proti zemní vlhkosti, tlakové vodě, speciálním kapalinám a radonu.
[Izolace proti vodě][46][Izolace tunelů][47][Chemické izolace][48][Izolace proti zemní vlhkosti][49]

### Systém pro izolaci jezírek a vodních ploch

Fólie a doplňky určené k izolaci zahradních jezírek, rybníků a biotopů.
[Izolace nádrží na pitnou vodu][50][Izolace vodohospodářských staveb][51][Izolace jezírek][52]

### Doplňky

Přispívají k vytvoření dokonalé těsnosti a účinnosti izolačního pláště.

dlaždice][56][Geotextilie][57]

For over 37 years, the expert masons and technicians at Fireplace Safety Services have been
exceeding the expectations and meeting the needs of residents and business owners throughout the
Greater San Francisco area.

With decades of experience, expert tools and techniques, and industry-leading training and
certification from the Chimney Safety Institute of America (CSIA) and the National Fireplace
Institute (NFI), our team of professionals have developed a reputation as the most trusted and most
qualified chimney care providers in the area.

Our number in Marin: (415) 479-1080 and in San Francisco (415) 252-0676

## Our Chimney Services

Maintaining and preserving your fireplace and chimney system doesn’t need to be a hassle or a
challenge. Here at Fireplace Safety Services, we make it our priority to provide you with quality,
worry-free services that you can trust.

We provide comprehensive care and services, including:
* [Sweep/Yearly Maintenance & Evaluation][96]
  1. [Chimney & Masonry Repairs][97]
  2. [Chimney Relining][98]
  3. [Rebuilds, Renovations & Restorations][99]
  4. [Troubleshooting][100]
  5. [Sheet Metal Work][101]
  6. [Gas & Wood-Burning Appliance Sales, Installation & Services][102]

The scope of our work covers chimney cleaning, repairs, remodels, and inspections. We do sales and
service of wood and gas burning fireplaces, inserts, and stoves, and troubleshooting all fireplace
problems. In short our expertise covers just about anything relating to providing a safe environment
for a fire in your home.

## Reasons To Do Business With Fireplace Safety Services
* We've been succesfully serving our customers since 1978
  1. Our technicians are certified by Chimney Safety Institute of America (CSIA)
  2. Our lead technician is also certified by the National Fireplace Institute (NFI)
  3. We are a small business and provide individualized service
  4. We pay attention to detail and use quality materials
  5. We have a great reputation for meeting or exceeding our customer's expectations
  6. We value our relationship with you and it shows in quality of our work

## Our Service Area

We are located right in beautiful Marin County in San Rafael, and provide comprehensive chimney care
throughout San Francisco, Marin, Sonoma, Napa and San Mateo counties. We travel to Cloverdale in the
north, La Honda in the south, Napa in the east, and all along the western coasts of San Francisco,
Marin, Sonoma and San Mateo counties. For a list of cities, towns and zip codes we service, please
click [here][103].

## Schedule Your Appointment With An Experienced & Certified Technician Today!

To find out more about our services and what sets us apart, or to schedule an appointment with one
of our pros, please give us a call at 415-252-0676 or click [here][104]. We are here for all of your
chimney and fireplace needs!

Whatever your [chimney service][105] needs, [Fireplace Safety Services][106] are the pros you can
rely on for quality, professional performance.

## About Us

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

[Read More][41]

### HISTORY

### BUSINESS

### Strategy

### CSR

OUR BRANDS

Products

## Automotive Refinish

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

[Read More][45]

## Resin

The company produces a range of resins, especially Alkyd resins, which are included in many types of
paints in the way and proportion that suits the needs and requirements of these paints

[Read More][46]

refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural

complex roofing, exterior envelope systems, and architectural wall cladding for demanding projects
across multiple markets nationwide. As a full-service commercial contractor, roofing is at the core
of our work. As one of the leading commercial metal roofing contractors in Wheeling and throughout
the Mid-Atlantic, we bring four decades of experience to every project.

## Our commitments

Founded in France, Onduline has been designing innovative roofing and waterproofing solutions for
more than 80 years. Our internationally renowned expertise enables us to lead the market of
lightweight roofing systems.

[More about Onduline][60]

### Quality

We are constantly improving the quality of our products to ensure customer satisfaction.

### Compliance

Our product ranges comply with construction standards in all the countries where we operate.

### Carbon Footprint and Recycled Content

The carbon footprint is 5.49 kg CO2/m² for Onduline roofing sheets, and 4.46 kg CO2/m² for ISOLINE
underlay sheets. Our sheets contain between [45 and 51% recycled material][61].

# Onduline, expert international des toitures et de l'étanchéité

[Onduline, international roofing and waterproofing expert]

## Onduline, international roofing and waterproofing expert

 

[Stay on the Corporate site ][57]
[
[Close-up of Onduline roofing panels in various colors ]

## Discover our products

Our solutions for roofing and waterproofing

][58]
[
[View of a restaurant in the Philippines with a roof made of red Onduline sheets]

## Go to country websites

Do you have a question about roofing and waterproofing? Our experts can help!  

][59]

 

## Our commitments

Founded in France, Onduline has been designing innovative roofing and waterproofing solutions for
more than 80 years. Our internationally renowned expertise enables us to lead the market of
lightweight roofing systems.

[More about Onduline][60]

### Quality

We are constantly improving the quality of our products to ensure customer satisfaction.

### Compliance

Our product ranges comply with construction standards in all the countries where we operate.

### Carbon Footprint and Recycled Content

The carbon footprint is 5.49 kg CO2/m² for Onduline roofing sheets, and 4.46 kg CO2/m² for ISOLINE
underlay sheets. Our sheets contain between [45 and 51% recycled material][61].

][66]

[
[Bituline waterproofing membrane]
][68]

### [BITULINE ][69]

High-quality waterproofing membrane for flat roofs, low slope roofs and foundations
[
[Storage facility ONDUCLAIR]
][70]

Translucent and opaque solutions in polyester and polycarbonate for roofing and cladding

Asphalt shingles for all application types

**HONGSHI**

**Introduction**

Hongshi is a key brand under OYH, playing a strategic role in the Group’s upstream deployment in the
new materials sector. The brand is dedicated to the research and development, lean manufacturing,
and quality management of water-based, eco-friendly vinyl acetate–ethylene (VAE) copolymer emulsions
and redispersible polymer powders (VAEP), delivering high-performance, sustainable raw material
solutions for diversified markets.

Driven by technological innovation and a diversified market strategy, Hongshi is rapidly expanding
its global brand presence.

 

**Mission**

To provide society and families with green, eco-friendly functional chemicals.

 

**Slogan**

Dedicated to delivering products and service with integrity and commitment.

 

**Main Products**

TDF

Established in 2011, Tiandingfeng (TDF) is a leading high-tech non-wovens brand and a top global
supplier of WBM (waterproofing bitumen membrane) carriers.

**TDF**

**Introduction**

Established in 2011, Tiandingfeng (TDF) is a leading brand dedicated to the development and
production of all kinds of high-tech nonwovens. After years of rapid development, TDF has grown into
TOP 10 players of nonwovens industry, and the world's leading WBM(waterproofing bitumen membranes)
carriers supplier.

Tiandingfeng specializes in WBM carriers, high tenacity coarsedenier polypropylenespunbond
needle-punched nonwoven geotextiles, filter materials and many other industrial nonwovens. By
offering tailored products and professional solutions, Tiandingfeng has become a trusted material
partner for major waterproofing brands and key infrastructure projects—including airports, water
conservancy works, railways, and highways.

 

**Vision**

To achieve the world's top level in nonwovens industry, to be global roofing carrier manufacturer
leader.

 

**Mission**

To create sustainable and safe environment for human society.

 

**Main Products**

Golden Wrapping

Golden Wrapping, a high-tech brand under OYH, is dedicated to the innovation and advancement of
special functional films. Since its official registration in 2020, the brand has rapidly evolved
into a leading provider of comprehensive film products and system solutions.

**Golden Wrapping**

**Introduction**

Golden Wrapping, a high-tech brand under OYH, is dedicated to the innovation and advancement of
special functional films. Since its official registration in 2020, the brand has rapidly evolved
into a leading provider of comprehensive film products and system solutions.

Specializing in BOPP, BOPE, CPP, release films, barrier films, composite films, PV films, and
waterproof films for building materials, Golden Wrapping serves a wide range of applications across
food packaging, industrial packaging, architecture, electronics, and more. Its solutions empower
strategic industries such as packaging, construction, and electronics, actively supporting
innovation and sustainable development.

 

**Main Products**

and quality management of water-based, eco-friendly vinyl acetate–ethylene (VAE) copolymer emulsions
and redispersible polymer powders (VAEP), delivering high-performance, sustainable raw material
solutions for diversified markets.

Driven by technological innovation and a diversified market strategy, Hongshi is rapidly expanding
its global brand presence.

 

**Mission**

To provide society and families with green, eco-friendly functional chemicals.

 

**Slogan**

Dedicated to delivering products and service with integrity and commitment.

Established in 2011, Tiandingfeng (TDF) is a leading high-tech non-wovens brand and a top global
supplier of WBM (waterproofing bitumen membrane) carriers.

**TDF**

**Introduction**

Established in 2011, Tiandingfeng (TDF) is a leading brand dedicated to the development and
production of all kinds of high-tech nonwovens. After years of rapid development, TDF has grown into
TOP 10 players of nonwovens industry, and the world's leading WBM(waterproofing bitumen membranes)
carriers supplier.

Tiandingfeng specializes in WBM carriers, high tenacity coarsedenier polypropylenespunbond
needle-punched nonwoven geotextiles, filter materials and many other industrial nonwovens. By
offering tailored products and professional solutions, Tiandingfeng has become a trusted material
partner for major waterproofing brands and key infrastructure projects—including airports, water
conservancy works, railways, and highways.

 

**Vision**

To achieve the world's top level in nonwovens industry, to be global roofing carrier manufacturer
leader.

 

**Mission**

To create sustainable and safe environment for human society.

special functional films. Since its official registration in 2020, the brand has rapidly evolved
into a leading provider of comprehensive film products and system solutions.

**Golden Wrapping**

**Introduction**

Golden Wrapping, a high-tech brand under OYH, is dedicated to the innovation and advancement of
special functional films. Since its official registration in 2020, the brand has rapidly evolved
into a leading provider of comprehensive film products and system solutions.

Specializing in BOPP, BOPE, CPP, release films, barrier films, composite films, PV films, and
waterproof films for building materials, Golden Wrapping serves a wide range of applications across
food packaging, industrial packaging, architecture, electronics, and more. Its solutions empower
strategic industries such as packaging, construction, and electronics, actively supporting
innovation and sustainable development.

## Budujemy bezpieczeństwo dla zrównoważonego świata

Zwiększamy nasze zaangażowanie w rozwój zrównoważonego budownictwa. Uważnie śledzimy trendy i zmiany
w otaczającym nas świecie. Nieustannie pracujemy nad minimalizacją naszego wpływu na środowisko i
racjonalnym zarządzaniem zasobami. Jako spółka odpowiedzialna społecznie działamy na skalę
międzynarodową, tworząc bezpieczne miejsca pracy dla naszych pracowników.
[ Dowiedz się więcej ][33]

## Selena R&D – Badania i Rozwój

Tworzymy innowacyjne produkty zderzając nowoczesną naukę i potrzeby pracowników budowlanych. Nasze
laboratoria wyposażone są w wysokiej jakości sprzęt analityczny, co pozwala nam dogłębnie
analizować, testować i rozwijać produkty dla branży budowlanej. Łączymy technologie z różnych grup
produktowych tworząc nowe, nieznane dotychczas na rynku, rozwiązania.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

# Thome Waterproofing Company

### Serving ALL of Los Angeles County, Ventura County & surrounding areas.

Thome Waterproofing Company is committed to addressing your waterproofing and coating needs and
providing reliable, long-lasting results. Over our many years in the waterproofing service business,
we have established ourselves as a leader in the residential and commercial sectors while constantly
adapting to the evolving waterproofing and coating technology and trends in the field. We strive to
exceed the expectations of every client by understanding the challenges presented and meeting them
head-on with a strategy and approach backed by years of professional experience.

Thome Waterproofing Company provides consistent, dependable results through a combination of expert
installation and high-quality materials.

Our waterproofing services include:

[**Below-Grade Waterproofing**][27] — Below-grade (below ground level) waterproofing should be used
any time a wall is retaining earth. In addition to being crucial to the long-term integrity of the
wall, waterproofing will help keep you and your possessions dry, and your walls free of
efflorescence and algae. For those considering our services prior to construction, bear in mind that
fixing water leaks and the subsequent damage caused by them after a building is complete is much
more expensive than preventing it by applying the appropriate waterproofing during construction.

[**Decorative** **Coatings**][28] — Thome Waterproofing Company’s services extend beyond prevention
and repair to cosmetic applications. We offer an assortment of beautiful decorative coatings for
pool decks, first-floor walkways, patios, driveways, or any other concrete on-grade location for
homes and businesses in which waterproofing is not required.

[**Planter** **Waterproofing**][29] — While attractive, if not properly waterproofed, planters over
living space can lead to costly repairs for mold abatement, framing repair, landscaping costs, and
the replacement of surrounding finish materials such as stucco, deck coating, and dry-wall—not to
mention the cost of re-waterproofing the planter itself. Head off these costs by ensuring that your
planter is professionally waterproofed by Thome Waterproofing’s seasoned experts.

[**Deck** **Waterproofing Coatings**][30] — Whether you have a balcony or deck that requires
repairs, removal, and replacement, or new construction, Thome Waterproofing has the proper
waterproofing systems and experienced, professional installers for the job, unlike other
waterproofing companies.

With our large staff of highly skilled waterproofing experts, we are able to serve all of Los
Angeles County & Ventura County including Encino, Santa Monica, Los Angeles, Bel-Air, Calabasas,
Studio City, Pacific Palisades, Hollywood Hills, Beverly Hills, Van Nuys, Canoga Park & other
surrounding areas.

# Thome Waterproofing Company

### Serving ALL of Los Angeles County, Ventura County & surrounding areas.

Thome Waterproofing Company is committed to addressing your waterproofing and coating needs and
providing reliable, long-lasting results. Over our many years in the waterproofing service business,
we have established ourselves as a leader in the residential and commercial sectors while constantly
adapting to the evolving waterproofing and coating technology and trends in the field. We strive to
exceed the expectations of every client by understanding the challenges presented and meeting them
head-on with a strategy and approach backed by years of professional experience.

Thome Waterproofing Company provides consistent, dependable results through a combination of expert
installation and high-quality materials.

Our waterproofing services include:

[**Below-Grade Waterproofing**][27] — Below-grade (below ground level) waterproofing should be used
any time a wall is retaining earth. In addition to being crucial to the long-term integrity of the
wall, waterproofing will help keep you and your possessions dry, and your walls free of
efflorescence and algae. For those considering our services prior to construction, bear in mind that
fixing water leaks and the subsequent damage caused by them after a building is complete is much
more expensive than preventing it by applying the appropriate waterproofing during construction.

[**Decorative** **Coatings**][28] — Thome Waterproofing Company’s services extend beyond prevention
and repair to cosmetic applications. We offer an assortment of beautiful decorative coatings for
pool decks, first-floor walkways, patios, driveways, or any other concrete on-grade location for
homes and businesses in which waterproofing is not required.

[**Planter** **Waterproofing**][29] — While attractive, if not properly waterproofed, planters over
living space can lead to costly repairs for mold abatement, framing repair, landscaping costs, and
the replacement of surrounding finish materials such as stucco, deck coating, and dry-wall—not to
mention the cost of re-waterproofing the planter itself. Head off these costs by ensuring that your
planter is professionally waterproofed by Thome Waterproofing’s seasoned experts.

[**Deck** **Waterproofing Coatings**][30] — Whether you have a balcony or deck that requires
repairs, removal, and replacement, or new construction, Thome Waterproofing has the proper
waterproofing systems and experienced, professional installers for the job, unlike other
waterproofing companies.

With our large staff of highly skilled waterproofing experts, we are able to serve all of Los
Angeles County & Ventura County including Encino, Santa Monica, Los Angeles, Bel-Air, Calabasas,
Studio City, Pacific Palisades, Hollywood Hills, Beverly Hills, Van Nuys, Canoga Park & other
surrounding areas.

  * [Roofs][32]
    Back
    * [Triflex ProTect][33]
      Back
      [Intelligent roof protection]
      Triflex ProTect
      
      Triflex ProTect is an ultra versatile, highly durable roof waterproofing solution, ideal for
      both refurbishment and new-build. It is compatible with almost all roof build-ups and existing
      substrates, including single ply.
      
      [Find out more][34]
    * [Triflex ProThan][35]
      Back
      [ProThan Teaser]
      Triflex ProThan
      
      Triflex ProThan is an odour free waterproofing solution ideal for use in sensitive
      environments. The cold liquid applied system does not require any hot works and can also be
      used internally within buildings without the requirement for additional ventilation.
      
      [Find out more][36]
    * [Triflex ProDetail][37]
      Back
      [Triflex ProDetail menu teaser image]
      Triflex ProDetail
      
       Triflex ProDetail is the proven, reliable solution for the fast and easy seamless
      waterproofing of virtually all details, including upstands, gutters, cut edge corrosion and
      roof penetrations.
      
      [Find out more][38]
    * [Triflex SmartTec][39]
      Back
      [Triflex SmartTec Teaser]
      Triflex SmartTec
      
      Triflex SmartTec is a single component, virtually odourless reinforced waterproofing system
      for roofs and internal areas. The system can be applied to numerous substrates without a
      primer, providing exceptional levels of vapour permeability.
      
      [Find out more][40]
    * [Triflex ProFibre][41]
      Back
      [ProFibre Teaser]
      Triflex ProFibre
      
      Triflex ProFibre is designed for fast and easy waterproofing of challenging and complex
      details. Utilising our unique solvent free fibre reinforced technology with ultra rapid cure
      times, even at low temperatures.
      
      [Find out more][42]
    * [Triflex FlexSealer][43]
      Back
      Triflex FlexSealer
      
      The Triflex FlexSealer waterproof sealer is a flexible, pourable waterproofing developed for
      awkward roof penetrations and sealing pitch pockets and pipe pockets.
      
      [Find out more][44]
    * [Triflex SmartTec Fibre Temporary Repair Kit][45]
      Back
      [Image of the Triflex SmartTec Fibre Temporary Repair Kit mega menu teaser]
      Triflex SmartTec Fibre Temporary Repair Kit
      
      Triflex SmartTec Fibre Temporary Repair Kit contains everything for emergency or temporary
      flat roof repair. The self-contained, van ready repair kit includes enough materials for
      several small patch roof repairs.
      
      [Find out more][46]
    [Intelligent roof protection]
    Intelligent roof protection
    
    Our wide range of highly certified, seamless, liquid applied waterproofing, surfacing and
    coating systems for flat roof waterproofing, detailing and repairs.
    
    [Find out more][47]
  * [Walkways, balconies and terraces][48]
    Back
    * [Triflex ProFloor][49]
      Back
      [ProFloor menu Teaser]
      Triflex ProFloor
      
      Triflex ProFloor is a partially reinforced system for use on cantilevered structures and over
      unoccupied spaces. The system is ultra fast curing, cold liquid applied and fully
      customisable.
      
      [Find out more][50]
    * [Triflex ProTerra][51]
      Back
      [Triflex ProTerra menu Teaser]
      Triflex ProTerra
      
      Triflex ProTerra is designed to waterproof and surface walkways, balconies and terraces over
      occupied premises. Providing a combination of reliable, long term waterproofing, highly
      durable surfacing and attractive design.
      
      [Find out more][52]
    * [Triflex ProTerra Buried][53]
      Back
      [ProTerra Buried teaser]
      Triflex ProTerra Buried

      Triflex ProTerra Insulated
      
      Triflex ProTerra Insulated provides an insulated build up for walkways, balconies or terraces.
      Utilising high quality warm roof insulation, an impact resistant topping and a durable and
      decorative waterproofing and surfacing finish.
      
      [Find out more][56]

      Back
      [ProDrain Teaser]
      Triflex ProDrain
      
      Triflex ProDrain offers a safe, clean solution for saturated and contaminated
      substrates. Featuring a self-supporting isolating and venting sheet that enables the
      subsequent Triflex ProTerra waterproofing and surfacing system to be applied over it.

      applied waterproofing systems.
      
      [Find out more][60]
    [Walkway, balcony, terrace menu teaser]
    Let's head outside
    
    Sophisticated waterproofing and surfacing solutions for walkways, balconies and terraces with an
    exceptional range of colour, texture and design options. The only limit is your imagination!
    
    [Find out more][61]

    Back
    * [Triflex ProPark][63]
      Back
      [propark Teaser]
      Triflex ProPark
      
      Triflex ProPark not only prolongs building life but also answers all of your waterproofing,
      surfacing, safety, aesthetic and design needs. The heavy duty, dynamic crack bridging system
      is certified to the highest standards including BBA and EN 1504-2.
      
      [Find out more][64]
    * [Triflex DeckFloor][65]
      Back
      [DeckFloor Teaser]
      Triflex DeckFloor
      
      Triflex DeckFloor is suitable for car park decks and ramps over parking and internal decks and
      ramps over occupied spaces. The heavy duty, flexible system incorporates a high tensile
      strength reinforcement in high risk areas.
      
      [Find out more][66]
    * [Triflex DeckCoat][67]
      Back
      [DeckCoat]
      Triflex DeckCoat
      
      Studies have shown that the worst degradation to the reinforcement of a car park occurs on the
      lower levels and ramps. Triflex DeckCoat waterproofs, surfaces and protects these areas to
      ensure that the structure is not compromised.
      
      [Find out more][68]

      Back
      [DeckDefence]
      Triflex DeckDefence
      
      Featuring a solvent free epoxy based waterproof coating layer with an exceptionally rapid
      curing PMMA finish. Triflex DeckDefence is a cost-effective solution for internal concrete
      decks and ramps over parking or ground bearing concrete decks and ramps.
      
      [Find out more][70]
    * [Triflex DeckDefence Epoxy][71]
      Back
      [DeckDefence Epoxy]
      Triflex DeckDefence Epoxy
      
      Triflex DeckDefence Epoxy utilises solvent free epoxy resin technology that cures without the
      additional need for ventilation, making it ideal for fully enclosed or underground car parks.
      
      [Find out more][72]

      surfacing system for vehicle service decks over occupied premises and high risk service decks
      subject to significant structural movement and associated cracking.
      
      [Find out more][74]

      and water repellents.

Hongyuan Waterproof supplies integrated waterproofing systems for commercial roofing, underground
engineering, tunnels, bridges, metro projects, water conservancy facilities, and civil buildings.
Our product range covers HDPE self-adhesive waterproof membrane, PVC membrane, EPDM rubber membrane,
TPO roofing membrane, bitumen membrane, polyurethane waterproof coating, acrylic coating,
cementitious coating, polyurea coating, and matching accessories.

For contractors and distributors, stable production capacity is as important as product performance.
Hongyuan operates 4 production bases with 62 advanced production lines, allowing us to support bulk
orders, customized specifications, OEM requirements, and consistent delivery schedules. Each
waterproof membrane and coating series is developed for practical jobsite needs such as tensile
strength, elongation, puncture resistance, weather resistance, adhesion, flexibility, and long-term
water tightness.

Our technical team helps customers select the right waterproofing material according to substrate,
climate, installation method, project budget, and required service life. Whether the application
requires a torch-applied bitumen sheet, a pre-applied HDPE membrane for basement slabs, a
liquid-applied polyurethane coating for complex details, or a TPO/PVC roof membrane system with
fasteners and tapes, Hongyuan can provide product guidance and project-ready supply.

Different waterproofing projects need different material systems. For below-grade concrete
structures, HDPE pre-applied membrane creates a tight bond with poured concrete and helps reduce
water migration between the slab and waterproof layer. For exposed roofing projects, PVC, TPO, and
EPDM membranes offer durable weather resistance, flexible installation, and long service life. For
irregular details, pipe roots, parapets, corners, and repair areas, liquid waterproof coatings can
form a continuous seamless layer around complex shapes.

Hongyuan also supports buyers who need complete accessory matching. Fasteners, termination bars,
vapor retarder tapes, internal corners, external corners, drainage accessories, and other supporting
products help installers complete a reliable system instead of relying on isolated materials. A
well-designed waterproofing system improves installation efficiency, reduces leakage risk, and makes
long-term maintenance easier for project owners.

As a China waterproofing manufacturer serving global markets, we focus on practical product
performance, export-ready packaging, and responsive communication. Our team can provide product
photos, technical data, application suggestions, loading guidance, and quotation support for
distributors, contractors, engineering companies, and building material importers looking for
long-term waterproof membrane and coating supply.

Quality control begins with raw material selection and continues through production, inspection,
packaging, and shipment. Depending on product type, our team reviews key performance indicators such
as thickness, tensile strength, elongation, peel strength, low-temperature flexibility, heat
resistance, water impermeability, solid content, bonding strength, and curing behavior. This process
helps customers receive waterproofing materials that match project requirements and reduce
uncertainty during installation.

We also understand that export customers need more than a product list. A reliable waterproofing
supplier should answer technical questions quickly, recommend suitable loading quantities, support
mixed product orders, and provide documentation that helps local sales teams explain product value.
Hongyuan works with overseas partners to build repeatable supply programs for roofing membranes,
below-grade membranes, liquid coatings, and waterproofing accessories.

From early product comparison to final shipment, our goal is to make waterproofing procurement
clearer and more predictable. Buyers can request membrane samples, coating specifications, accessory
recommendations, and quote options based on their project type. This helps teams choose the right
waterproofing system before materials arrive on site, saving time during installation and reducing
avoidable leakage risks after completion.

For repeat purchasing programs, Hongyuan can coordinate product series, packaging marks, shipping
schedules, and after-sales communication so distributors can serve local roofing, basement, tunnel,
and infrastructure customers with a stable waterproofing supply chain.
